mapper.insert:
SELECT SQ_EMPLOYEE.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO employee (employee_id, company_id, employee_no, employee_name, department_id, job_grade_id, hire_date, employment_status) VALUES (#{employeeId}, #{companyId}, #{employeeNo}, #{employeeName}, #{departmentId}, #{jobGradeId}, #{hireDate}, #{employmentStatus})

SELECT SQ_USER_ACCOUNT.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO user_account (user_account_id, company_id, employee_id, email, password_hash, role_code, status_code, activated_at) VALUES (#{userAccountId}, #{companyId}, #{employeeId}, #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{roleCode}, #{statusCode}, CASE WHEN #{statusCode} = 'ACTIVE' THEN END)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee e JOIN user_account a ON a.employee_id = e.employee_id AND a.company_id = e.company_id WHERE e.company_id = #{companyId} AND e.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND e.employment_status = 'ST_SERVING' AND a.status_code = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT branch_id FROM employee WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND employee_id = #{employeeId}

SELECT e.employee_id, e.employee_name, d.department_name FROM employee e JOIN user_account a ON a.employee_id = e.employee_id AND a.company_id = e.company_id LEFT JOIN department d ON d.department_id = e.department_id WHERE e.company_id = #{companyId} AND e.employment_status = 'ST_SERVING' AND a.status_code = 'ACTIVE' AND a.role_code IN #{role} ORDER BY d.sort_order, d.department_name, e.employee_name, e.employee_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_account WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND status_code = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT e.employee_id, e.employee_name, e.employee_no, d.department_name, d.department_type, CASE WHEN d.head_employee_id = e.employee_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS head, g.grade_name, a.role_code, a.status_code, a.created_at, e.employment_status, e.employment_type, e.gender_code FROM employee e JOIN user_account a ON a.employee_id = e.employee_id AND a.company_id = e.company_id LEFT JOIN department d ON d.department_id = e.department_id LEFT JOIN job_grade g ON g.job_grade_id = e.job_grade_id WHERE e.company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY d.sort_order, d.department_name, e.employee_no

SELECT e.employee_id, e.employee_name, e.department_id, d.department_name, a.status_code,a.role_code, e.employment_status, CASE WHEN d.head_employee_id = e.employee_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS head FROM employee e JOIN user_account a ON a.employee_id = e.employee_id AND a.company_id = e.company_id LEFT JOIN department d ON d.department_id = e.department_id AND d.company_id = e.company_id WHERE e.company_id = #{companyId} AND e.employee_no = #{employeeNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE employee SET employment_type = #{empType}, employment_status = #{work}, gender_code = #{gender}, retire_date = CASE WHEN #{work} = 'ST_RETIRED' THEN NVL(retire_date, TRUNC()) ELSE NULL END, updated_at = WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND employee_id = #{employeeId}
mapper.select: SELECT c.company_name, d.department_name AS dept_name, g.grade_name AS rank_name, (SELECT hd.department_name FROM department hd WHERE hd.company_id = e.company_id AND hd.head_employee_id = e.employee_id AND hd.use_yn = 'Y' AND ROWNUM = 1) AS head_dept_name FROM employee e JOIN company c ON c.company_id = e.company_id LEFT JOIN department d ON d.department_id = e.department_id AND d.company_id = e.company_id LEFT JOIN job_grade g ON g.job_grade_id = e.job_grade_id AND g.company_id = e.company_id WHERE e.company_id = #{companyId} AND e.employee_id = #{employeeId}
